project_tracker_diagnostic: Annual; usually branching; broad rough leaves, often opposite below and alternate above; heads with dark disk and yellow rays; achenes 2-awned.

project_inclusion.learning_reason: Common and useful Central Texas field-learning taxon.

morphology_keys.habit: Erect, usually branching herb, often coarse and rough-hispid.
morphology_keys.leaves: Lower leaves opposite, upper alternate; blades broadly ovate to deltoid-ovate, rough, often long-petiolate below.
morphology_keys.heads: Usually several to many heads on branching stems; rays yellow; disk florets yellow to darkening with age.
morphology_keys.phyllaries: Broadly lanceolate to ovate, ciliate-hispid, spreading to somewhat reflexed.
morphology_keys.fruit: Achenes typically dark, flattened, often with 2 caducous awns.

photo_strategy.selection_logic: Prefer curated taxon photos plus multiple views from one Central Texas/Texas observation.
